opex.notes: Footnote: "Expenses include VAT at 5% (not recoverable)." Footnote also says "Chiller (Empower) is paid by tenants directly", so there is no district cooling line. No vacancy or collection loss, utilities_common, or security/cleaning lines appear. In the cell grid the amounts sit in columns D and E inconsistently; the cells are cited as extracted.

discrepancies.title: OM yield 6.8% is on asking price, before 6.2% acquisition costs

sources.label: acquisition costs (DLD 4%, broker, trustee, mortgage registration)

discrepancies.why: A buyer pays AED 8,143,445 on top of the price. On price plus costs the same income gives 6.4%.

impact.basis: OM income on price plus acquisition costs, minus the stated yield

discrepancies.analyst_action: Compare deals on yield on total cost; ask the broker to restate the yield on that basis.

discrepancies.title: Cover says 'fully tenanted' but the OM itself states 96% occupied
discrepancies.why: The OM contradicts itself on occupancy. The rent roll shows 4 vacant units, 2 under renewal and 2 with notice served. The headline AED 8.91 million annual rental income and the 6.80% ROI are quoted against a building described as fully let. The figure should be reconciled to contracted rent on let units only.
discrepancies.analyst_action: Request the Ejari-backed rent roll and the tenancy contracts. Confirm which units are vacant, under renewal or on notice. Confirm whether the AED 8.91 million includes the vacant units, then re-base the yield on in-place rent.

rejected_model_findings.title: OM describes 96 individual title deeds and an owners association, not a single title

evidence.quote: Individual title deeds allow flexible exit - sell in bulk or unit by unit
Building managed by a RERA-registered owners association; service charges paid through Mollak.

rejected_model_findings.why: The OM says freehold, but it also describes individual title deeds for each unit, an owners association and Mollak service charges. That points to a strata-type structure, not one single title deed. A buyer would then acquire 96 separate unit titles. That affects the transfer process, how many transfers are needed, owners-association voting rights and service-charge exposure. Title and fees may differ from a single-title building.
rejected_model_findings.analyst_action: Send to legal review. Request the title deeds for all 96 units (or the single title deed), the plot's title or Oqood records, the owners association registration, and the Mollak service-charge statements. Confirm that the seller owns every unit.
rejected_model_findings.rejected_because: the OM states freehold tenure (verified) and no quoted evidence names a tenure or eligibility restriction; strata ownership is tested by the mandate's title filter

memo.markdown:
## Verdict
**Pass.** The deal fails a hard filter first: the title is freehold strata, and the mandate requires freehold single title. It also fails the hard Year-1 DSCR test at 1.18x [[uw.dscr_year1]] against the 1.30x [[mandate.min_dscr_year1.threshold]] floor. It misses all three return targets (yield on cost, levered IRR, equity multiple).

Recommendation: do not proceed to full diligence at the asking price of AED 131.00m [[deal.asking_price_aed]]. The walk-away price is AED 96.19m [[uw.walk_away_price_aed]], which is 26.57% [[uw.walk_away_discount_to_asking]] below asking. The levered IRR target sets that price. Even at that price, the title test still fails.

## The deal
- Aurelia Bay Tower, Business Bay: 96 units [[om.unit_count]], completed 2017 [[deal.completion_year]], floors B+G+3P+12.
- Asking price AED 131.00m [[deal.asking_price_aed]]. That is AED 1,095 per sq ft [[om.price_psf_stated]] on BUA (the OM's basis) and AED 1,711 per sq ft [[uw.price_per_sqft_nsa]] on NSA.
- Income comes from direct leases with no master tenant. In-place rent is AED 8.91m [[rr.in_place_rent_aed]] with 95.83% [[rr.occupancy_by_units]] occupancy by units: 92 let units [[rr.let_units]] and 4 vacant [[rr.vacant_units]] (rent roll dated 31 October 2026 [[rr.as_of]]). Tenants pay chiller costs.

## Returns and key metrics
| Metric | Underwritten | Mandate |
|---|---|---|
| Year-1 NOI | AED 6.49m [[uw.noi_year1]] | none |
| Going-in net yield on total cost | 4.66% [[uw.going_in_net_yield_on_cost]] | 6.00% [[mandate.min_going_in_net_yield_on_cost.threshold]] |
| Year-1 DSCR | 1.18x [[uw.dscr_year1]] | 1.30x [[mandate.min_dscr_year1.threshold]] |
| Levered IRR (pre-tax) | -4.62% [[uw.levered_irr_pre_tax]] | 8.00% [[mandate.target_levered_irr.threshold]] |
| Levered equity multiple (pre-tax) | 0.80x [[uw.levered_equity_multiple_pre_tax]] | 1.35x [[mandate.target_equity_multiple.threshold]] |

The OM headline yield is 6.80% [[om.yield_stated]], on asking price, with the income measure unstated. On the buyer's basis (Year-1 NOI on price plus acquisition costs) it is 4.66% [[uw.om_yield.buyer_net_on_total_cost]]. That is 2.14% [[uw.om_yield.gap_vs_stated]] below the OM figure, taking the gap as the engine states it.

## What would make it fail
- **Exit value below purchase price.** At a 6.25% [[uw.exit_yield]] exit yield, gross exit value is AED 111.17m [[uw.gross_exit_value_aed]], well under the price. Levered IRR is negative in nearly every grid cell. With the exit yield 50 bps [[uw.sens.exit_shift_step_bps]] wider, it is -7.26% [[uw.sens.r+0.e+50.levered_irr_pre_tax]]. With market rent 5% [[uw.sens.rent_shift_step]] lower as well, it is -9.96% [[uw.sens.r-5.e+50.levered_irr_pre_tax]]. The best case is market rent 5% [[uw.sens.rent_shift_step]] higher and the exit yield 50 bps [[uw.sens.exit_shift_step_bps]] tighter, at only 0.36% [[uw.sens.r+5.e-50.levered_irr_pre_tax]].
- **No debt cushion.** Loan interest is 6.80% [[uw.interest_rate]]. With market rent 5% [[uw.sens.rent_shift_step]] lower, DSCR falls to 1.15x [[uw.sens.r-5.e+0.dscr_year1]]. Occupancy of 83.71% [[uw.breakeven_occupancy_dscr_1]] is where NOI just covers debt service.
- **Costs understated in the statement.** The operating statement shows NOI of AED 7.06m [[opex.noi_aed]]. It has no utilities or security and cleaning lines. The screen added mandate defaults of AED 153k [[uw.opex_default.utilities_common]] and AED 230k [[uw.opex_default.security_cleaning]], which gives Year-1 NOI of AED 6.49m [[uw.noi_year1]]. Real costs could differ either way.
- **Rollover in one window.** 30.84% [[uw.max_expiry_share_quarter]] of in-place rent, AED 2.75m [[uw.max_expiry_window_rent_aed]], expires between 30 April 2027 [[uw.max_expiry_window_start]] and 30 July 2027 [[uw.max_expiry_window_end]]. That is inside the 40.00% [[mandate.max_lease_expiry_share_in_any_quarter.threshold]] limit. The rent path assumes market rent falls 4.00% [[assume.rent_growth_year1]] in Year 1, so renewals carry risk. Over-renting is not a concern: 1.11% [[uw.over_rent_share_of_income]] of income.

## Discrepancies that matter
1. **OM yield ignores acquisition costs (medium).** The OM's 6.80% [[om.yield_stated]] is on asking price, before acquisition costs of 6.22% [[uw.acquisition_costs_pct_of_price]] of price. The screen recomputed it itself rather than use the OM figure. On price plus costs the OM's own income gives 6.40% [[uw.om_yield.stated_income_on_total_cost]], a change of -0.40% [[disc.yield_excludes_acquisition_costs.impact_delta]]. The buyer's NOI gives a lower figure still (see above).
2. **"Fully tenanted" versus occupancy (low).** The OM cover says fully tenanted, but the OM states 96.00% [[om.occupancy_stated]] occupied. The rent roll shows 4 vacant units [[rr.vacant_units]], 2 under renewal [[rr.status.under_renewal]] and 2 on notice [[rr.status.notice_served]]. The screen relied on the rent roll. The OM's rent of AED 8.91m [[om.annual_rent_stated]] has no stated basis.

Other lower-severity items are not discussed.

## Before diligence, check
- Legal title: confirm the strata structure and whether single title is achievable at all.
- Ejari-backed rent roll and tenancy contracts. Confirm which units are vacant, under renewal or on notice, and what the OM's rent figure includes.
- Broker restatement of the yield on total cost.
- Full operating statement, including utilities, security and cleaning, and the service charge and sinking fund detail.
- Chiller arrangement and who bears the cost.
- Lender terms, because cover is below the floor.
- Security deposits to be transferred to the buyer.

## Assumptions
Leverage is 45.00% [[assume.ltv]] loan to value. The rate is 4.30% [[assume.eibor]] EIBOR plus a 2.50% [[assume.margin]] margin, on a 20-year [[assume.amortisation_years]] amortisation. Structural vacancy is 5.00% [[assume.structural_vacancy]], collection loss 1.00% [[assume.collection_loss]], renewal probability 70.00% [[assume.renewal_probability]] and management fee 5.00% [[assume.management_fee]] of income. The hold is 5 years [[uw.hold_years]] from 1 January 2027 [[uw.analysis_start]]. The exit yield of 6.25% [[uw.exit_yield]] includes 25 bps [[assume.exit_yield_expansion_bps]] of expansion. Market rent changes by -4.00% [[assume.rent_growth_year1]], -1.00% [[assume.rent_growth_year2]], 2.00% [[assume.rent_growth_year3]], 3.00% [[assume.rent_growth_year4]] and 3.00% [[assume.rent_growth_year5]] in Years 1 to 5. Mandate defaults filled the utilities and security and cleaning costs, which the package lacked.
